The woman on the right is wearing a red pantsuit. Both women are smiling at the camera. A logo labeled “Sister Circle Live” is displayed in the lower left corner of the screen. Behind them, a large window reveals a view of a skyline and trees. A clip then appears, showing an actress from a scene from the film “Pride and Prejudice Atlanta” from the Lifetime TV network. In the scene, the woman is wearing a black and white striped top. She is talking to other actors in the scene who are dressed in church attire. Text appears, providing context for the scene, reading, “And flirt a little more…” and “Kitty, Who never stops telling us every single thing she’s thinking, she needs to read a lot more and gossip a lot less.” The next text states, “And there’s my oldest…” The clip ends, and the scene transitions back to the two women on the sofa. They are clapping, and the camera focuses on the show’s stage, where an actress in a floral dress appears and strikes a pose with hand gestures. The camera follows her as she walks around the set, eventually approaching the two women on the sofa.
